Thanks — I reviewed acme_redlines_v3.pdf and pulled out the items that will need discussion. High-level summary for the agenda:

1) Indemnity & liability cap: Acme is requesting a higher carve-out for third-party data processing claims (Redwood typically pushes back here).
2) Audit & logging access: Acme requests near-real-time access and retention beyond our standard 90 days; we should discuss alternatives (redacted logs, retention ETAs).
3) Data residency & export controls: confirm whether any EU/region-specific language is required (likely not for this deal, but flagging).
4) Termination / transition assistance: timelines and costs for extracting customer data.

If we are being asked to move on the audit retention item, this likely needs leadership sign-off. Vivek — can you weigh in if we should pre‑approve a limited exception (e.g., 120 days) or hold firm at 90?

Proposed meeting agenda (45 min):
- 0–5m: quick intros & objectives (Hannah)
- 5–15m: Acme top priorities (Emily / procurement)
- 15–30m: Legal & technical redlines — focus on indemnity, retention (Marissa / Sergio)
- 30–40m: Possible concessions / options & owners (Vivek if needed)
- 40–45m: Next steps / action items

Attaching legal_summary_redlines.pdf (condensed). Please flag any other clauses you want on the agenda.

-Marissa
